claims.text: The authors compare MERF against ANGE, ATEEMA, GENTREE, and NUMNORM, which are task-specific information extraction techniques.
MERF is also compared with TEXTMARKER, a semi-automatic rule-based information extraction system.
SystemT is mentioned as a comparison point, which uses an algebraic approach to information extraction.
